outcomeNote: A bare mishnaic clause with no dispute and no named party; its explanation follows in the next unit.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַחַיָּיב בִּשְׁקֵדִים הַמָּרִים – פָּטוּר בַּמְּתוּקִים, הַחַיָּיב בַּמְּתוּקִים – פָּטוּר בַּמָּרִים.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to the obligation of separating teruma and tithes, the stage of development «that» is «obligated in bitter almonds» is «exempt in sweet» almonds; and the stage in development «that» is «obligated in sweet» almonds is «exempt in bitter» almonds.

moves.summary: states the paired inversion for bitter and sweet almonds, continuing the chapter's series of inversions
